additional_concerns: The formula answers only activation under the stipulated request-conditioned reading. TRUE does not establish demonstration, compliance, SFC satisfaction or fulfilment; FALSE does not extinguish confirmation or underlying duties.

Footnote 5 also admits an independently unqualified demonstration reading. The candidate deliberately selects the parent-paragraph reading; its executable result does not resolve that interpretive alternative or the reach of 'with a high level of confidence'.
No actual request or scope facts are supplied. Both classifications require assessment, and missing evidence must remain UNKNOWN rather than become FALSE.

Complete paragraphs 10–13, footnote 2 and the referenced Appendix factors are absent. They are needed for a fuller substantive compliance assessment, but not to express this stipulated request trigger. No supplied external dependency IDs identify them.

Paragraph 16 concerns a separate request for a satisfactory legal opinion. Neither that request, paragraph 15 procurement, nor UT Code register maintenance establishes paragraph 14 activation automatically.
No unsupported operational permission or additional trigger restriction appears in the formula. The structural tool PASS establishes neither legal interpretation nor factual applicability.
